OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_SCOPE.description: The scope of the connector, i.e. the entity types it imports.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD.description: Time to wait between two runs of the connector, as an ISO 8601 duration (e.g. `PT6H` for six hours). Every run reads the full rule set.

ELASTIC_DETECTION_RULES_KIBANA_URL.description: Base URL of Kibana, without the space prefix (e.g. `https://kibana.example.com:5601`).

ELASTIC_DETECTION_RULES_API_KEY.description: Encoded Elasticsearch API key (the base64 `id:api_key` value), sent as `Authorization: ApiKey <key>`. It needs the Kibana privilege `Security > Rules and Exceptions: Read` in the space.

ELASTIC_DETECTION_RULES_SPACE_ID.description: Kibana space holding the rules. Leave empty for the default space.

ELASTIC_DETECTION_RULES_RULE_FILTER.description: Optional KQL filter on rule attributes passed to the detection engine `_find` API (e.g. `alert.attributes.tags:"Production"`).

ELASTIC_DETECTION_RULES_IMPORT_DISABLED_.description: Import disabled rules too, with the deployment status `deployed` (enabled rules get `active`). When false, disabled rules are left out and count as removed.

ELASTIC_DETECTION_RULES_PAGE_SIZE.description: Rules requested per page of the `_find` API.

ELASTIC_DETECTION_RULES_REQUEST_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout of each HTTP request, in seconds.

ELASTIC_DETECTION_RULES_MAX_RETRIES.description: Retries of a request failing with a rate limit (429), a server error (5xx) or a network error, with exponential backoff.

ELASTIC_DETECTION_RULES_VERIFY_SSL.description: Verify the TLS certificate of Kibana.

ELASTIC_DETECTION_RULES_PLATFORM_NAME.description: Name of the Security Platform the rules are deployed on in OpenCTI.

ELASTIC_DETECTION_RULES_PLATFORM_ID.description: Id (internal or STIX) of an existing Security Platform in OpenCTI the rules are deployed on, for example the one an Elastic integration of the same deployment reports to. Takes precedence over `platform_name` and `platform_type`: the connector references that platform and never rewrites it.

ELASTIC_DETECTION_RULES_TLP_LEVEL.description: TLP marking applied to every object this connector creates.
